status_definitions.confirmed_price_exact_match: Official Polish Dacia Shop card confirmed; current catalogue price captured and equal to the document price.
status_definitions.confirmed_card_price_not_captured: Official Polish Dacia Shop card confirmed; current catalogue price was not exposed by the bounded retrieval.
status_definitions.dacia_pl_card_not_resolved: No official Polish Dacia Shop card was resolved in the bounded retrieval; no withdrawal, incompatibility or unavailability inference.

boundaries: Every price-list reference has one first-pass status.
A Polish Dacia Shop card is confirmed only by exact part-number evidence on the official Polish Dacia Shop domain.
A missing captured price is not a mismatch.
An unresolved card is not classified as withdrawn, incompatible or unavailable.
No same-day retry is represented as new evidence.
Official Renault Shop, foreign-market Dacia and third-party records are not transferred to Polish New Spring evidence.
